description: When a Technician Utilization download starts, the message reads "Success / Data exported successfully" — generic wording that names neither the report nor the file type. When a download fails, no message appears at all: the user is left with no file and no explanation.
steps: Open Reports, then Technician Utilization, and set the date range to This Quarter.
Open the three-dot menu, choose Summary (CSV), and read the message that appears.
Now set the date range to This Year and choose Expanded (PDF).

Wait about forty seconds and watch for any message. This was seen with the date range This Year (1 January to 6 August 2026), which returns 29 technicians, active location Staging Heavy Duty - 9919, on an account that can also reach Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
current:
The successful download showed "Success / Data exported successfully.", the same wording for all four options.

The failed download showed nothing. The server answered with an error after roughly half a minute, no file arrived, and no message of any kind was displayed. The screen was watched continuously for forty-five seconds afterwards, and no file was produced.

For triage: the reason the Expanded PDF fails on a large view is reported separately as SV-8818. This ticket is only about the messages. The same generic success wording on Parts Velocity is SV-8936.
expected: A download that starts says "Download started". A download that fails says "Failed to download report".
source: When a download starts, the user sees a success notification: "Download started".
If a download fails, the user sees an error notification: "Failed to download report".

Both wordings appear a second time in the notifications table in section 7 of the same description, where the trigger "A download starts" is paired with "Download started" and "A download fails" with "Failed to download report".
